answer: Require every identity to earn on a capped payout terrace: at most 40 paid submissions per epoch, checked within seconds by a rotating auditor pool on a ledger. A new identity starts at zero paid weight and needs 3 epochs of grading before its terrace rises, so a hollow account with no history cannot sell influence. Entry needs a 60-token bond locked 25 epochs, 100% slashed on proven duplication. Auditors rotate by a zephyr draw the applicant cannot choose, and a cluster sharing one funding source freezes after its third failed audit. 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 tokens for 40,000 capped payouts.
